show.description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonia secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her 'family', while Sonia's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonia's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.
